runs.name: Deer Consumer Products, Inc.; OTC DEER, formerly Nasdaq DEER (suspended 2013-01-11, Form 25-NSE effective 2013-04-01), SEC CIK 0001388855, Nevada, formerly Tag Events Corp. until 2008-08-13, fiscal year to December 31, US dollars translated from RMB; a Chinese designer, manufacturer and seller of small home and kitchen electric appliances under the Deer brand in China and as ODM/OEM for export, plants in Yangjiang with land in Wuhu; no filing by the company since the 8-K of 2013-08-13
runs.box: OUT AT Q2; integrity facts recorded, not judged
runs.entry: Price **$0.0002** (OTC close 2026-10-16, Yahoo chart data, aggregator, flagged; 33 of the last 251 sessions show volume, 1,000 shares that day; the OTC Markets API was down, so the tier is not confirmed). Shares **33,592,562** (10-Q for 2012-06-30, 0001185185-12-001666, cover as of 2012-08-09; the FY2011 balance sheet the same with no treasury line; the SC 13G of 2014-08-12 computes on the same count); whether shares were issued or cancelled since 2012 cannot be known; market value about $6,700; `cover_shares.py` and `tools/run.py` both failed (the ticker has left the SEC ticker map), owner cash computed by hand from the filed cash-flow statements and XBRL read by CIK. Sovereign for the earnings currency (RMB): **2.06%**, the 30-year point of the PRC Ministry of Finance government bond yield curve (published on yield.chinabond.com.cn), dated 2026-10-16; no RMB row in the protocol's table. Read from the FY2011 10-K (0001185185-12-000545, filed 2012-03-29), the FY2010 10-K and 10-K/A, the FY2009 10-K/A, the FY2008 10-K, the 10-Qs for 2012-03-31 and 2012-06-30, the DEF 14A of 2011-08-08, the SEC staff correspondence of 2011, the 8-Ks of 2011 to 2013 and the Form 25-NSE of 2013-03-22 (0001354457-13-000062); **the company has filed nothing since the 8-K of 2013-08-13** (last statements to 2012-06-30; no Form 15 and no 12(j) order on EDGAR; a law firm's 2017 release on a shareholder group seeking a receivership, no receiver found); cross-check: 2011 operating cash $5,968,640 and revenue $226,748,885 in XBRL equal the filed statements; the 2011 construction line of investing cash ($17,587,593) carries no XBRL tag. Lines of evidence derived by the analyst from the 10-K's Items 1, 1A and 7 and the 8-Ks. The 10-K names Midea, Hisense, Galanz, Supor, Elec-Tech and Tsann Kuen, **none an SEC filer, all flagged**; Global-Tech (20-F, 0001193125-12-311223), a Guangdong ODM of small appliances, used as a comparator of the analyst's choosing, labelled. **Q1 IN** **[M2012-065]**, **[M2008-033]**, **[M2000-141]**, **[M2023-030]**: small kitchen appliances (blenders, juicers, soy milk makers), 68% of 2011 revenue in China under the Deer brand, 32% exported as ODM/OEM, economics foreseeable in kind; the absence of any statement after 2012-06-30 carried to Q4 and the Nevada, BVI and PRC structure to Q5 (named as a framework gap: a second analyst could close at Q1 TOO HARD). **Q2 OUT** **[M2011-015]**, **[M2006-013]**, **[M2017-009]**, **[L2004-003]**, **[M1997-010]**, **[M1999-108]**, **[M2012-106]**: the castle shown open on the filer's own statements: it prices "at slight discount to the products of other domestic brands", export customers set the specifications, designs and price points while new rivals come from lower-labour-cost countries, Gome 38% of 2011 revenue, the patents and trademarks licensed from the CEO and his brother with the 2008 transfer never registered, its own brand built from launch in 2008 to $122.6M of sales by 2011 (money can enter), gross margin 21.6% to 30.5% only matching the roughly 30% industry average the 10-K cites; Global-Tech's margins 4% to 17% over the span and its exit from small kitchen appliances in January 2012. After the stop, facts recorded, not judged: NASDAQ Staff's delisting grounds of 2012-10-02 (false and misleading disclosure of the Yangjiang plant's operating status, incomplete answers on customers, suppliers and shippers, "a scheme to illicitly transfer corporate funds to a group of stockbrokers through a bogus consulting contract"); the audit committee chairman's pay cut to $1 a month on 2012-09-29 and his resignation on 2012-10-01; delisted effective 2013-04-01; the class action settled at about 4% of claimed damages, the company denying; suits against a short seller and Seeking Alpha in 2011; a material weakness at 2011-12-31; total assets at 2009-12-31 stated two ways; five years' net income $89.3M against operating cash $20.9M; cash $79.3M (2009, after a $93.6M offering) to $9.4M (2012-06-30) while inventory rose $18.1M to $79.4M and $36.4M went into Wuhu land with $26,620 of construction in H1 2012; no borrowings. COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: owner cash (all spending) -1.81, -1.16, -3.92, -45.03, -17.53 ($M, FY2007 to FY2011), average $(13.89)M, H1 2012 $(2.49)M; by (b) the all-spending series gives the no-growth case alone, by (e) the depreciation proxy the top; **value range $(19.78) to $4.00 a share** at 2.06%, net cash $9.88M at 2012-06-30; **no positive fair price**: $(1.39) a share, all-equity and equity-only the same (no debt); $1.11 if the depreciation proxy is read as the filing allowing the maintenance guess, not made central; not armed (box not OUT at Q7 or IN). Contamination declared by the analyst: WLGSF commit subjects in the session context, the AYI and ARCB research-folder names in git status, a memory index line on the queue; none used. Commits 8b6fd623 (template), b2da084e (Step 0 and Q1), 89381865 (Q2), cc325d84 (the rest). Position note filled at the fold: not held. Citations: the analyst's `check_ids.py` 0 problems across 33 ids; the dispatcher's `dispatcher_adjacent.py` checked 30 fragments beside an id, 0 problems; no E-ids; **no citation slip**. No tracked research file over 200 KB. check_framework PASS. **For the operator** (the analyst's framework notes): which question owns a company that has stopped reporting (Q1 TOO HARD against Q1 IN with the silence carried to Q4); no RMB sovereign row; the parts convention needs operating profit by part, which a one-segment filer never gives (a revenue rule confessed); rivals that file only on foreign exchanges; Q7 (b) against (e) when the all-spending series is negative and the depreciation series positive (whether the proxy counts as the filing allowing the maintenance guess decides a fair price of $(1.39) or $1.11); (f)'s cap at a 2.06% rate; eight to ten balance sheets impossible for a reverse-merger filer; the tools fail on a ticker gone from the SEC map though the CIK route works. Could not get: whether the PRC subsidiaries still operate, any accounts after 2012-06-30, whether the registration has been revoked, whether a receiver was appointed, the OTC tier, the rivals' own exchange filings.
runs.narr: OUT at Q2 (Deer Consumer Products, Inc., OTC DEER, formerly Nasdaq DEER, delisted 2013-04-01 after NASDAQ Staff's determination of 2012-10-02, silent on EDGAR since the 8-K of 2013-08-13, last statements to 2012-06-30; a Chinese maker of small kitchen appliances, Deer brand at home and ODM/OEM for export, with the castle shown open on its own statements: priced under domestic rivals, export customers setting specifications and price points, Gome 38% of revenue, patents and trademarks licensed from the CEO, its own brand built from nothing in three years, margins at the industry average; the six named rivals file nothing with the SEC. Facts recorded, not judged: NASDAQ's grounds (false disclosure of the Yangjiang plant's status, incomplete answers on customers and suppliers, an alleged bogus consulting contract to move funds to stockbrokers), the audit chairman's pay cut to $1 and his resignation, the class action settled at about 4%, five years' net income $89.3M against operating cash $20.9M. Computation beneath the stop: owner cash negative all five years, value range $(19.78) to $4.00 a share, no positive fair price ($(1.39)), against $0.0002, not armed. No citation slip. Framework gaps for the operator: a company that has stopped reporting, no RMB sovereign row (Ministry of Finance 30-year 2.06% used), the parts rule for a one-segment filer, rivals on foreign exchanges only, Q7 (b) against (e), eight to ten balance sheets impossible, the tools on a ticker gone from the SEC map.)
